MarketSource.description: Where the market status came from.

oneOf.description: The exchange clock message (`mx/timestamp`, source `MX`): its open/holiday flags.

No exchange clock: the exchange time is the price cards' update time and
open/holiday come from the exchange calendar (`qp-calendar`, XIST).

PhaseCode.description: One instrument's session phase as the feed gives it (Matriks `stockStatus`).

code.description:
The feed's code (`stockStatus`, e.g. 2). Never shown to the reader; the authority
does not pass it to readers (0, not sent).

description:
(R6/T3, §24) What the host knows about the market now. An input of the authority
(`Session::set_market_status`), next to — not instead of — the clock.

delayed.description: The feed is the delayed one (15 minutes).

exchange_time.description:
The exchange's time (UTC ms): the clock message's, else the newest price card's
update time (15 minutes behind in delayed mode). While stale: the last data's.

holiday.description: Whether today is an exchange holiday (`None`: unknown).

open.description: Whether the equity market is open (`None`: unknown).

phases.description: Session phase by instrument symbol (as the price cards last gave it).

stale.description: The live connection is down (or stopped): the data is stale (`BindingState::Stale`).

title: MarketStatus
